scope:
TEE Lab skeleton native spatial review; production GLSL, actual resident CT.
This is scientific EGL rendering, not a browser screenshot or device-performance test.

provenance.kind: BodyParts3D thorax with illustrative surrounding organs
provenance.insertionScale: Model distance; the 35 cm ME marker is illustrative, not measured from incisors.
provenance.presentation: Reference skin and thoracic bones are cropped for context. The accepted heart and cut face take display priority over foreground and rear context. One fixed smooth fit adjusts only the intact reference skeleton; every bone triangle is retained and the skin, GI tract and source heart stay fixed.
provenance.attribution: BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science, CC BY 4.0
provenance.transform: One fixed reference-center-to-AV-frame similarity with specimen-envelope torso scaling; no view-dependent transform.

skeletonFit.method: One fixed smooth depth fit shared by the intact reference spine, ribs, sternum and clavicles.
skeletonFit.coordinateSystem: Patient-left, superior, anterior reference millimetres relative to the fixed body reference origin.

provenance.limitations: The fixed specimen has no acquired body. Reference anatomy, body axes and probe contact windows are illustrative; no clinical registration is claimed.

heartMask: Exact resident-volume color difference from the same production shader with threshold 2 (background only), before adding any context or probe. Skeleton ON/OFF comparison precedes shared guide strokes.
limitations: Native EGL, not browser screenshot or physical-device validation.
Resident 317–318 µm measured display source; no fresh 79.4 µm volume or Ultra/local replacement meshes.
Fixed illustrative surrounding anatomy is not clinical patient registration.
Font callouts omitted; source probe/sector geometry and fitted bones preserved.
